bootstrap: 100 paired Rao-Wu rescaled PSU samples within NHANES wave and design stratum
CV: refitted in each full-cohort bootstrap, held fixed within its 23 group models
prior_coarse_results: Retained for audit; group arrays 569361 and 569362 canceled before publication analysis because coarse baseline grid shifted estimates.

adaptive_high_refinement.evidence: In 190 complete group tasks, 1337/1337 high-grid first starts converged within 0.005 NLL of the final multistart result; largest improvement from later starts was 0.000071 NLL.
adaptive_high_refinement.policy: Retain coarse multistart. After a converged first 320-cell refinement, stop other high-grid starts except for every 20th replicate-group task; if first refinement fails, run fallback starts.
adaptive_high_refinement.mixed_code_note: Jobs already running at deployment use the original loaded code; jobs starting afterward use the updated code.

group_bootstrap_scope.reason: User asked to avoid overkill; 50 paired resamples suffice for the intended AIC stability check; 100 full-cohort baseline draws retained for Figure 3b.
